slot.chapter: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
slot.brief: Same accelerating potential applied to electron vs proton (or two KEs); compare de Broglie wavelengths via λ ∝ 1/√(mK).

stem: An electron and a proton are accelerated from rest through the same potential difference. If lambda_e and lambda_p are their de Broglie wavelengths, then the ratio lambda_p/lambda_e is:

verdicts.working: For nonrelativistic acceleration through potential difference V, p=√(2meV), so λ=h/p and λp/λe=√(me/mp).

working:
lambda = h / sqrt(2 m q V). For same q and V, lambda is proportional to 1/sqrt(m). Therefore lambda_p/lambda_e = sqrt(m_e/m_p).
